title: Blood Wedding
creator: Carlos Saura
description: Antonio Gades’s flamenco company dances Lorca’s tragedy of a bride who runs off with her old lover on her wedding day. Carlos Saura films a full dress rehearsal in a bare studio, with almost no words. Lorca wrote the play in 1932.

title: La luz prodigiosa
creator: Miguel Hermoso
description: In August 1936 a young shepherd near Granada finds a badly wounded man who has survived a firing squad. Decades later he meets him again, with no memory of who he was. The film lets you wonder whether he is Lorca. In Spanish.

title: Sacromonte, los sabios de la tribu
creator: Chus Gutiérrez
description: “Sacromonte: The Wise Ones of the Tribe.” A documentary in which the older Romani flamenco artists of Sacromonte remember the cave quarter’s golden age, before floods in 1963 forced most families out. In Spanish.
